details: The Cronos blockchain experienced a halt following an estimated $75 million exploit on its largest lending protocol, Tectonic. An attacker reportedly manipulated the TONIC token to drain assets, with around $6 million being bridged to Ethereum before validators stopped the network.
title: Cronos Network Halted After Tectonic Exploit

details: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) resumed its Bitcoin acquisition, purchasing 4,603 BTC for approximately $369.7 million between August 24-30 at an average price of $80,318 per coin. This brings the company's total holdings to 845,050 bitcoins.
title: Strategy Buys $370 Million in Bitcoin, Ending Hiatus

details: Russia's largest bank, Sberbank, projects that regulated crypto trading volume on exchanges could reach up to 4 trillion rubles ($46.4 billion) in the first year after new crypto legislation takes effect on September 1, 2026. The bank also plans to offer crypto-backed loans using Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, pending central bank approval.
title: Russia's Sberbank Forecasts $46 Billion First-Year Crypto Trading

details: Bitcoin concluded August with its strongest performance in nine years, gaining approximately 23.5%. However, a CryptoSlate price prediction model forecasts a more volatile September with a projected median gain of 4.7% by month-end, with prices potentially ranging from $72,502 to $91,049. Recent data also shows outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs, while Ethereum ETFs continue to see inflows.
title: Bitcoin Sees Strong August, Analysts Eye Volatile September

details: Hyperliquid Labs is reportedly in talks to offer crypto perpetual futures to U.S. traders through a partnership with Payward, the parent company of Kraken. The proposed arrangement would see Payward subsidiary Bitnomial provide access to Hyperliquid's decentralized exchange markets, pending regulatory approval from the CFTC.
title: Hyperliquid Partners with Kraken Parent for US Perpetual Futures
